title: Make it better: refine & iterate
goal: AI is a conversation — refine with follow-ups, don't restart.

blocks.title: It's a conversation
blocks.body:
Your draft is good. Great teachers make it great.

Don't start over — refine. Ask for: "make it easier", "add 3 more", "shorten", "add a worked example", "make question 4 multiple-choice".

blocks.question: Your weaker students are struggling with the worksheet. What's the best follow-up?

options.text: Start over with a brand-new prompt
"Make it a bit easier and add one worked example"

blocks.explanation: A specific, small follow-up keeps what works and fixes what doesn't — that's the skill.

blocks.scaffold: Improve this — make it a little easier and add one worked example.

blocks.question: How confident do you feel refining AI output now?
